applies_why: The judge text gives UNDERDETERMINED for Isaiah 7:14 because the parties addressed its virgin/young-woman wording and prophetic application separately, so it is deciding a single-verse two-sense issue under the rule.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand. — one reading bars UNDERDETERMINED when a verse is treated as having two senses; the other treats separately answered aspects as leaving the verse open.
why: The judge declared UNDERDETERMINED by treating Isaiah 7:14's virgin/young-woman wording and prophetic application as unresolved separate senses, contrary to K-S2's command that such a two-sense verse is not open and both senses stand.
